name: HeaderPanel

props.name: addFocusListeners
props.description: Specify whether focus and blur listeners are added. They are by default.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Specify whether the panel is expanded

props.name: href
props.description: Provide the `href` to the id of the element on your package that could be target.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon HeaderPanel rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
